h1: Custom 12 oz Workwear for Your Team
metaDescription: Shop custom 12 oz workwear with your logo. Durable, comfortable, and perfect for branding. Order bulk from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 12 oz workwear offers the ideal balance of weight and durability for teams that need reliable gear without the bulk of heavier fabrics. This midweight cotton or cotton-blend material provides enough heft to hold up to daily wear while remaining comfortable for active jobs. Safety managers and HR directors often choose 12 oz work shirts and jackets for warehouse crews, field technicians, and outdoor teams who require breathable yet tough apparel. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered names for a professional look that lasts.
